dn15:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo.
dn15:1.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn15:1.5: yāva gambhīro cāyaṃ bhante, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso ca. atha ca pana me uttānakuttānako viya khāyatī”ti.
dn15:1.6: mā hevaṃ ānanda avaca, mā hevaṃ ānanda avaca.
dn15:1.7: gambhīro cāyaṃ ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso ca.
dn15:1.8: etassa ānanda, dhammassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamayaṃ pajā tantākulakajātā guḷāguṇḍikajātā muñjababbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattati.
dn15:2.1: atthi idappaccayā jarāmaraṇanti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthiti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.2: kimpaccayā jarāmaraṇanti iti ce vadeyya, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.3: atthi idappaccayā jātīti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.4: kimpaccayā jātīti iti ce vadeyya, bhavapaccayā jātīti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.5: atthi idappaccayā bhavo’ti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.6: kimpaccayā bhavo’ti iti ce vadeyya, upādānapaccayā bhavo’ti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.7: atthi idappaccayā upādānanti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.8: kimpaccayā upādānanti iti ce vadeyya, taṇhāpaccayā upādānanti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.9: atthi idappaccayā taṇhā’ti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.10: kimpaccayā taṇhā’ti iti ce vadeyya, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā’ti iccassa vacanīyaṃ,
dn15:2.11: atthi idappaccayā vedanā’ti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.12: kimpaccayā vedanā’ti iti ce vadeyya, phassapaccayā vedanā’ti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.13: atthi idappaccayā phasso’ti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.14: kimpaccayā phasso’ti iti ce vadeyya, nāmarūpapaccayā phasso’ti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.15: atthi idappaccayā nāmarūpanti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.16: kimpaccayā nāmarūpanti iti ce vadeyya, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.17: atthi idappaccayā viññāṇanti iti puṭṭhena satā ānanda, atthīti’ssa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:2.18: kimpaccayā viññāṇanti iti ce vadeyya, nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇanti iccassa vacanīyaṃ.
dn15:3.1: iti kho ānanda, nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
dn15:4.1: “jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ:
dn15:4.2: jāti ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:4.3: devānaṃ vā devattāya, gandhabbānaṃ vā gandhabbattāya, yakkhānaṃ vā yakkhattāya, bhūtānaṃ vā bhūtattāya, manussānaṃ vā manussattāya, catuppadānaṃ vā catuppadattāya. pakkhīnaṃ vā pakkhīttāya, siriṃsapānaṃ vā siriṃsapattāya, tesaṃ tesañca ānanda, sattānaṃ tathattāya jāti nābhavissa, sabbaso jātiyā asati jātinirodhā api nu kho jarāmaraṇaṃ paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:4.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo jarāmaraṇassa yadidaṃ jāti”.
dn15:5.1: “bhavapaccayā jātīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā bhavapaccayā jāti:
dn15:5.2: bhavo ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:5.3: kāmabhavo rūpabhavo arūpabhavo, sabbaso bhave asati bhavanirodhā api nu kho jāti paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:5.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo jātiyā yadidaṃ bhavo”.
dn15:6.1: “upādānapaccayā bhavo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā upādānapaccayā bhavo:
dn15:6.2: upādānaṃ ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:6.3: kāmūpādānaṃ vā diṭṭhūpādānaṃ vā sīlabbatūpādānaṃ vā attavādūpādānaṃ vā, sabbaso upādāne asati upādānanirodhā api nu kho bhavo paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:6.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo bhavassa yadidaṃ upādānaṃ”.
dn15:7.1: taṇhāpaccayā upādānanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ:
dn15:7.2: taṇhā ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:7.3: rūpataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā, sabbaso taṇhāya asati taṇhānirodhā api nu kho upādānaṃ paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:7.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo upādānassa yadidaṃ taṇhā”.
dn15:8.1: “vedanāpaccayā taṇhā’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, iminā petaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā:
dn15:8.2: vedanā ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:8.3: cakkhusamphassajā vedanā sotasamphassajā vedanā ghānasamphassajā vedanā jivhāsamphassajā vedanā kāyasamphassajā vedanā manosamphassajā vedanā, sabbaso vedanāya asati vedanānirodhā api nu kho taṇhā paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:8.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo taṇhāya yadidaṃ vedanā”.
dn15:9.1: iti kho panetaṃ ānanda, vedanaṃ paṭicca taṇhā, taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā, pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho, lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo, vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo, chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānaṃ, ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho, pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyaṃ, macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho,
dn15:9.2: ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ paṭicca daṇḍādāna-satthādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvantuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti.
dn15:10.1: ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍādāna-satthādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvantuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavantīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍādāna-satthādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvantuvaṃ-pesiñña-musāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti:
dn15:10.2: ārakkho ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso ārakkhe asati ārakkhanirodhā api nu kho daṇḍādāna-satthādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvantuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhaveyyunti?
dn15:10.4: tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo daṇḍādāna-satthādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvantuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādānaṃ anekesaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ sambhavāya yadidaṃ ārakkho.
dn15:11.1: macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho:
dn15:11.2: macchariyaṃ ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso macchariye asati macchariyanirodhā api nu kho ārakkho paññāyethāti?
dn15:11.4: tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo ārakkhassa yadidaṃ macchariyaṃ.
dn15:12.1: pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyaṃ:
dn15:12.2: pariggaho ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso pariggahe asati pariggahanirodhā api nu kho macchariyaṃ paññāyethāti?
dn15:12.4: tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo macchariyassa yadidaṃ pariggaho.
dn15:13.1: “ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho:
dn15:13.2: ajjhosānaṃ ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso ajjhosāne asati ajjhosāna nirodhā api nu kho pariggaho paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:13.4: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo pariggahassa yadidaṃ ajjhosānaṃ”.
dn15:14.1: “chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānaṃ:
dn15:14.2: chandarāgo ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso chandarāge asati chandarāganirodhā api nu kho ajjhosānaṃ paññāyethā?ti.”
dn15:14.4: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo ajjhosānassa yadidaṃ chandarāgo”.
dn15:15.1: “vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo:
dn15:15.2: vinicchayo ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso vinicchaye asati vinicchayanirodhā api nu kho chandarāgo paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:15.4: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo chandarāgassa yadidaṃ vinicchayo”.
dn15:16.1: “lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo:
dn15:16.2: lābho ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso lābhe asati lābhanirodhā api nu kho vinicchayo paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:16.4: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo vinicchayassa yadidaṃ lābho”.
dn15:17.1: “pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho:
dn15:17.2: pariyesanā ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso pariyesanāya asati pariyesanānirodhā api nu kho lābho paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:17.4: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo lābhassa yadidaṃ pariyesanā”.
dn15:18.1: taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā:
dn15:18.2: taṇhā ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:18.3: kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā, sabbaso taṇhānirodhā api nu kho pariyesanā paññāyethā?ti.
dn15:18.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo pariyesanāya yadidaṃ taṇhā.
dn15:18.6: iti kho ānanda, ime dve dhammā dvayena vedanāya ekasamosaraṇā bhavanti”.
dn15:19.1: “phassapaccayā vedanā’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, iminā petaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā phassapaccayā vedanā:
dn15:19.2: phasso ca hi ānanda, nābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyathidaṃ:
dn15:19.3: cakkhusamphasso sotasamphasso ghānasamphasso jivhāsamphasso kāyasamphasso manosamphasso, sabbaso phasse asati phassanirodhā api nu kho vedanā paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:19.5: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo vedanāya yadidaṃ phasso”.
dn15:20.1: “nāmarūpapaccayā phasso’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā nāmarūpapaccayā phasso:
dn15:20.2: yehi ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho rūpakāye adhivacanasamphasso paññāyethāti?”
dn15:20.4: “yehi ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi rūpakāyassa paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho nāmakāye paṭighasamphasso paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:20.6: “yehi ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa ca rūpakāyassa ca paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho adhivacanasamphasso vā paṭighasamphasso vā paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:20.8: “yehi ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmarūpassa paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho phasso paññāyethā?”ti.
dn15:20.10: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo phassassa yadidaṃ nāmarūpaṃ”.
dn15:21.1: “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ.
dn15:21.2: viññāṇaṃ ca hi ānanda, mātukucchismiṃ na okkamissatha, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ mātukucchismiṃ samuccissathā”ti?
dn15:21.4: “viññāṇaṃ ca hi ānanda, mātukucchiṃ okkamitvā vokkamissatha, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ itthattāya abhinibbattissathāti”?
dn15:21.6: “viññāṇaṃ ca hi ānanda, daharasseva sato vocchijjissatha kumārakassa vā kumārikāya vā, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissathāti”?
dn15:21.8: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo nāmarūpassa yadidaṃ viññāṇaṃ”.
dn15:22.1: “nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. tadānanda, imināpetaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ:
dn15:22.2: viññāṇaṃ ca hi ānanda, nāmarūpe patiṭṭhaṃ na labhissatha, api nu kho āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasamudayasambhavo paññāyethāti”?
dn15:22.4: “tasmātihānanda, eseva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo viññāṇassa, yadidaṃ nāmarūpaṃ.”
dn15:22.5: ettāvatā kho ānanda, jāyetha vā jīyetha vā mīyetha vā cavetha vā upapajjetha vā,
dn15:22.6: ettāvatā adhivacanapatho, ettāvatā niruttipatho, ettāvatā viññattipatho, ettāvatā paññāvacaraṃ, ettāvatā vaṭṭaṃ vattati, (ettāvatā) itthattaṃ paññāpanāya, yadidaṃ nāmarūpaṃ saha viññāṇena aññamaññapaccayatā pavattati.”
dn15:23.2: rūpiṃ vā hi ānanda, parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti
dn15:23.4: rūpiṃ vā hi ānanda, anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti
dn15:23.6: ‘arūpiṃ vā hi ānanda, parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti
dn15:23.8: arūpiṃ vā hi ānanda, anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti
dn15:24.1: “tatrānanda, yo so rūpiṃ parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti,
dn15:24.2: etarahi vā so rūpiṃ parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. tattha bhāviṃ vā so rūpiṃ parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. ‘atathaṃ vā pana santaṃ tathattāya upakappessāmī’ti iti vā panassa hoti.
dn15:24.3: evaṃ santaṃ kho ānanda, rūpiṃ parittattānudiṭṭhi anusetīti iccālaṃ vacanāya.
dn15:24.4: “tatrānanda, yo so rūpiṃ anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti,
dn15:24.5: etarahi vā so rūpiṃ anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. tattha bhāviṃ vā so rūpiṃ anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. ‘atathaṃ vā pana santaṃ tathattāya upakappessāmī’ti iti vā panassa hoti.
dn15:24.6: evaṃ santaṃ kho ānanda, rūpiṃ anantattānudiṭṭhi anusetīti iccālaṃ vacanāya.
dn15:24.7: “tatrānanda, yo so arūpiṃ parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti,
dn15:24.8: etarahi vā so arūpiṃ parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. tattha bhāviṃ vā so arūpiṃ parittaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. ‘atathaṃ vā pana santaṃ tathattāya upakappessāmī’ti iti vā panassa hoti.
dn15:24.9: evaṃ santaṃ kho ānanda, arūpiṃ parittattānudiṭṭhi anusetīti iccālaṃ vacanāya.
dn15:24.10: “tatrānanda, yo so arūpiṃ anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti,
dn15:24.11: etarahi vā so arūpiṃ anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. tattha bhāviṃ vā so arūpiṃ anantaṃ attānaṃ paññapento paññapeti. ‘atathaṃ vā pana santaṃ tathattāya upakappessāmī’ti iti vā panassa hoti.

dn15:29.1: “sukhāpi kho ānanda, vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā.
dn15:29.2: dukkhāpi kho ānanda, vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā.
dn15:29.3: adukkhamasukhāpi kho ānanda, vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā.
dn15:29.4: tassa sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamānassa ‘eso me attā’ti hoti.
dn15:29.5: tassā yeva sukhāya vedanāya nirodhā ‘vyaggo me attā’ti hoti.
dn15:29.6: dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamānassa ‘eso me attā’ti hoti.
dn15:29.7: tassā yeva dukkhāya vedanāya nirodhā ‘vyaggo me attā’ti hoti.
dn15:29.8: adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamānassa ‘eso me attā’ti hoti.
dn15:29.9: tassā yeva adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā ‘vyaggo me attā’ti hoti.
dn15:29.10: iti so diṭṭheva dhamme aniccaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ vokiṇṇaṃ uppādavayadhammaṃ attānaṃ samanupassamāno samanupassati. yo so evamāha ‘vedanā me attā’ti.
dn15:29.11: tasmātihānanda, etenapetaṃ nakkhamati ‘vedanā me attā’ti samanupassituṃ.
dn15:30.2: ‘naheva kho me vedanā attā, appaṭisaṃvedano me attā’ti, so evamassa vacanīyo
dn15:30.3: ‘yattha panāvuso sabbaso vedayitaṃ natthi, api nu kho tattha ayamahamasmī’ti siyā?”ti.
dn15:30.5: “tasmātihānanda, etenapetaṃ nakkhamati ‘naheva kho me vedanā attā, appaṭisaṃvedano me attā’ti samanupassituṃ.
dn15:31.2: ‘naheva kho me vedanā attā, no’pi appaṭisaṃvedano me attā, attā me vedeti, vedanādhammo hi me attā’ti,
dn15:31.4: ‘vedanā ca hi āvuso sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyyuṃ,
dn15:31.5: sabbaso vedanāya asati vedanānirodhā api nu kho tattha ayamahamasmī’ti siyā?”ti.
dn15:31.7: “tasmātihānanda, etenapetaṃ nakkhamati ‘naheva kho me vedanā attā, no pi appaṭisaṃvedano me attā, attā me vedayati, vedanādhammo hi me attā’ti samanupassituṃ.”
dn15:32.1: “yato kho panānanda, bhikkhu neva vedanaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, no pi appaṭisaṃvedanaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, no pi ‘attā me vedayati vedanādhammo hi me attā’ti samanupassati,
dn15:32.2: so evaṃ asamanupassanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati,
dn15:32.3: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ yeva parinibbāyissati.
dn15:32.4: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
dn15:32.5: “evaṃ vimuttacittaṃ kho ānanda, bhikkhuṃ yo evaṃ vadeyya
dn15:32.7: “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā iti’ssa diṭṭhī”ti tadakallaṃ.
dn15:32.8: “hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā iti’ssa diṭṭhī”ti tadakallaṃ.
dn15:32.9: “neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā iti’ssa diṭṭhī”ti tadakallaṃ.
dn15:32.11: yāvatā ānanda, adhivacanaṃ, yāvatā adhivacanapatho, yāvatā nirutti, yāvatā niruttipatho, yāvatā paññatti, yāvatā paññattipatho, yāvatā paññā, yāvatā paññāvacaraṃ yāvatā vaṭṭaṃ vaṭṭati, tadabhiññā vimutto bhikkhu “tadabhiññā vimutto bhikkhu na jānāti na passati iti’ssa diṭṭhī”ti tadakallaṃ.
dn15:33.1: “satta kho imā ānanda, viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo, dve āyatanāni,
dn15:33.3: “santānanda, sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
dn15:33.5: “santānanda, sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino seyyathāpi devā brahmakāyikā paṭhamābhinibbattā.
dn15:33.7: “santānanda, sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino seyyathāpi devā ābhassarā.
dn15:33.9: “santānanda, sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā.
dn15:33.11: “santānanda, sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā.
dn15:33.13: “santānanda, sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā.
dn15:33.15: “santānanda, sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā.
dn15:34.1: tatrānanda, yāyaṃ paṭhamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti nānattakāyā nānattasaññino seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā,
dn15:34.2: yo nu kho ānanda, tañca pajānāti, tassā ca samudayaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca atthaṅgamaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca assādaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca ādīnavaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca nissaraṇaṃ pajānāti, kallaṃ nu tena tadabhinanditunti?”
dn15:34.3: “no hetaṃ bhante”. “tatrānanda, yāyaṃ dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti …pe… yāyaṃ tatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti …pe… yāyaṃ catutthā viññāṇaṭṭhiti …pe… yāyaṃ pañcamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti …pe… yāyaṃ chaṭṭhā viññāṇaṭṭhiti …pe…
dn15:34.4: tatrānanda, yāyaṃ sattamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī ti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā, yo nu kho ānanda, tañca pajānāti, tassā ca samudayaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca atthaṅgamaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca assādaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca ādīnavaṃ pajānāti, tassā ca nissaraṇaṃ pajānāti, kallaṃ nu tena tadabhinanditunti?” “no hetaṃ bhante”. “tatrānanda, yadidaṃ asaññasattāyatanaṃ,
dn15:34.5: yo nu kho ānanda, tañca pajānāti, tassa ca samudayaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca atthaṅgamaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca assādaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca ādīnavaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca nissaraṇaṃ pajānāti, kallaṃ nu tena tadabhinanditunti?”
dn15:34.8: yo nu kho ānanda, tañca pajānāti, tassa ca samudayaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca atthaṅgamaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca assādaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca ādīnavaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca nissaraṇaṃ pajānāti, kallaṃ nu tena tadabhinanditunti?”
dn15:34.10: “yato kho ānanda, bhikkhu imāsañca sattannaṃ viññāṇaṭṭhitinaṃ, imesañca dvinnaṃ āyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti. ayaṃ vuccatānanda, bhikkhu paññāvimutto.
dn15:35.9: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn15:35.11: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn15:35.13: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn15:35.15: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn15:35.17: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn15:36.1: “yato kho ānanda, bhikkhu ime aṭṭha vimokkhe anulomampi samāpajjati, paṭilomampi samāpajjati, anulomapaṭilomampi samāpajjati, yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi,
dn15:36.2: āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ vuccatānanda, bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto.
dn15:36.3: imāya ca ānanda, ubhatobhāgavimuttiyā aññā ubhatobhāgavimutti uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā natthī”ti.
dn15:36.5: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
